architecture.mechanism: Parallel supercapacitor energy buffering to absorb transient loads and stabilize battery terminal voltage
architecture.intervention: Install a 12V automotive-grade supercapacitor module in parallel with the stock lead-acid battery terminals under the hood, using existing battery clamp points compatible with Subaru electrical architecture
architecture.expected_effect: The supercapacitor supplies instantaneous high-current transients and maintains minimum system voltage during sudden parasitic drain events, preventing complete terminal voltage collapse that disables the remote keyless entry receiver and starter solenoid engagement
architecture.falsification_test: Connect a digital multimeter across the battery terminals while simulating a high-draw fault condition; if terminal voltage drops below 9.6V with the supercapacitor installed and connected, the mechanism fails to prevent discharge-induced failure
